question_text: What is the primary role of the Development Team, also known as Developers?

answers.answer_text: Ensure the team is building the right product
Maximize the value of the product delivered by the team
Help the team understand why their work matters

question_text: What are the primary responsibilities of a Product Owner? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: Ensures the Product Backlog is visible and transparent to all
Prioritizes the Product Backlog to optimize delivery and value to customers
Makes sure the product or service fulfills the customer’s needs

question_text: What is the primary role of the Scrum Master?

answers.answer_text: They ensure the team is building the right product.
They do the work to build the product.
They work to continuously maximize the value of the product delivered by the Scrum Team.
They promote and support the Scrum process by helping everyone understand and implement Scrum.

question_text: Imagine you are a Scrum Master coaching Developers to embrace the traits of an effective Development Team: being cross-functional, self-organizing, and supportive. Which additional trait should effective Development Teams display?

answers.answer_text: They should work as individuals rather than as a team.
They should share expertise in the same discipline.
They should operate independently, without direct oversight from the Product Owner.

question_text: In the three pillars of Scrum, what does transparency mean? Select all that apply.

answers.answer_text: Teams must be upfront and open with all stakeholders, including team members, customers, sponsors, and management.
Only team members who deal with vendors or stakeholders must be transparent.
Everyone on the team must be transparent in order to avoid mixed signals, breakdowns of communication, and unnecessary complications.
Teams must make the most significant aspects of their work visible to those responsible for the outcome.
